parameters.num_facilities: <int> Number of facilities (combined production plants and warehouses) in the distribution network.
parameters.num_customers: <int> Number of customers to be served in the distribution network.
parameters.num_periods: <int> Number of time periods in the planning horizon.

seasonal_factors: <list[float], length num_periods> Seasonal demand proportions shared by all customers, determining how each customer's total demand is distributed across periods.
facility_locations: <list[list[float]], shape [num_facilities][2]> Two-dimensional coordinates of each facility in the service region.
customer_locations: <list[list[float]], shape [num_customers][2]> Two-dimensional coordinates of each customer in the service region.
demands: <list[float], length num_customers> Total demand of each customer over the entire planning horizon.
holding_costs: <list[list[float]], shape [num_facilities][num_periods]> Per-unit cost of storing inventory at each facility at the end of each period.
capacities: <list[list[float]], shape [num_facilities][num_periods]> Maximum production capacity available at each facility in each period.
transportation_costs: <list[list[list[float]]], shape [num_facilities][num_customers][num_periods]> Cost of supplying each customer from each facility in each period.
